answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7319 Country: Canada Title: Is television haraam? Question: Is television haraam? Answer ID: 7319 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1617/1383=B/1429) Television is a tool of entertainment and amusement, the root cause of indecencies and obscenities, it has taken the place of cinema. Those who watch television watch haram programme and learn nudity and sinful acts. Therefore, watching television is haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
